column1: # Annotations that produced no name, and why. NAMED is DERIVED from the
# annot: tokens in the proposal tables and the names the tree defines --
# do not duplicate it here. A verdict and a citation are mutually exclusive;
# annotation_queue.py --check fails on an id carrying both.
# verdicts: CORROBORATES (agrees with a name already earned), NO_NAME (true,
# yields no rename), HELD (settled_by required), REJECTED (cannot support a name)

column6: names STORM_PARTICLE's subject from a witness that never read the tree; ../storm-particles/ earned the name as the intersection of amiga's ambient drift and msdos's particle tumble, and the family F00..F04 is already complete in both ports (INTRO.asm:376-380, drawn one per iteration at x=[0x07], y=[0x09] at 1145-1153)

measured: these are NOT members of CINEMATIC_PRISON_GREEN_TRACER_F0..F7 (0x864A..0x86B2, all eight drawn by one routine at PRISON.asm:2501-2515). They sit elsewhere in the bank (0x854A..0x8622) and are drawn by separate three-frame burst routines installed on their own channels -- DRAW_CIN_154_TO_156_3F_AT_A74B7DB1 on 0x38, DRAW_CIN_151_TO_153_3F_AT_40D20636 on 0x39 -- each opening with play id=0x0058 at a different freq/vol, all anchored x=160, y=[0x19]. So the subject the person gives (a sparkle of the lift) agrees with the tree's own neighbouring word, but the INDEX does not follow: three bursts of three, and F0..F7 already taken by the other family.
column7: what picks between the burst routines, and what [0x19] holds -- notes/dispatch-ladders/ for the first, and the y variable's writers for the second. Until then the family bounds are unknown and an index would be invented.
